about: Synthetic tasks for the agent-ready skill (agent-ready/ in this repo). Each one leans on an always-on rule: verify, don't assert; stop and ask when the spec cannot answer; never weaken a check; say what failed.

dimensions.execution: the work is done, correct, and checked by something the output shows
dimensions.intent: it does what the user asked, no more and no less, and says what it did not do

tasks.prompt: The add function in calc.py gives wrong answers. Fix it and prepare the change for the owner's review.
